description: AuditEvent derives #[serde(tag = "type", rename_all = "snake_case")] and also has an inherent event_type() method that manually maps each variant to a string. The two must be kept in sync by hand. The method should call serde_json::to_value(self) and extract the 'type' field, or the method should be removed in favour of extracting the tag from the serialized form. Either way the duplication is a maintenance hazard.
title: core: AuditEvent::event_type() duplicates the serde tag strings
